DETAIL-NULL-500.title: A stored null result still crashes the detail page
DETAIL-NULL-500.impact: The summary opens, but its Variants link returns HTTP 500 when a stored result is null.
DETAIL-NULL-500.retest: Open the same detail link, preserve the null value and show an explicit availability message.

DETAIL-UNAVAILABLE-NEGATIVE.title: Unavailable detail results are presented as a negative result
DETAIL-UNAVAILABLE-NEGATIVE.impact: A view without a supported stored detail result says No predicted resistance determinants. That wording can be mistaken for a completed negative result.
DETAIL-UNAVAILABLE-NEGATIVE.retest: Distinguish an unavailable detail result from an available result with zero rows, and identify which stored result type this view displays.

DETAIL-COMBINED-FILTER.title: The second numeric filter overrides the first
DETAIL-COMBINED-FILTER.impact: Combining frequency and depth filters can retain rows that fail the first condition. The displayed selection does not match the submitted conditions.
DETAIL-COMBINED-FILTER.retest: Combine one failing and one passing numeric condition. No row should remain unless both conditions hold.

DETAIL-DISMISSED-500.title: Hide dismissed returns a server error
DETAIL-DISMISSED-500.impact: The offered display filter reads a legacy field absent from current stored rows and returns HTTP 500.
DETAIL-DISMISSED-500.retest: Use existing saved decisions to hide exactly the rejected rows, without writing or changing any decision.

EMM-EXPORT-500.title: The configured S. pyogenes export cannot be downloaded
EMM-EXPORT-500.impact: The export formatter uses an outdated result-descriptor field. All ten existing S. pyogenes fixtures return HTTP 500 in both formats. An empty result also requires dictionary-shape handling.
EMM-EXPORT-500.retest: Read the current descriptor and preserve the existing empty-value fallback. Validate CSV/TSV structure and the saved record identity. Clinical interpretation of exported values is outside this check.

DETAIL-MISSING-500.title: A missing detail record returns HTTP 500
DETAIL-MISSING-500.impact: A stale or invalid detail URL becomes a server error instead of a clear unavailable-record response.
DETAIL-MISSING-500.retest: Return HTTP 404 for the missing record without attempting further reference or result reads.
